title: Codex entry
description: A player-facing knowledge entry — the codex / bestiary / glossary the player reads in-game. Distinct from /lore, which is authoring canon and never shipped: this is narrative text the player sees, so it lives in data/ and is localized like any other player-facing string.

name.description: Entry title as the player sees it.

category.description: Project-defined grouping for the codex UI, e.g. people / places / history. Free-form on purpose: the taxonomy is per-project, not a Parlance concept.

unlockedBy.description: Condition that reveals this entry. ABSENT MEANS ALWAYS UNLOCKED — unlike an ending, a codex entry is often available from the start.
